discovery.summary: Compare latest Treasury average rate with prior month
discovery.description: Select one official U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data monthly average-interest-rate category, compare the latest observation with the prior month, and return rising, falling, unchanged, or human_review using a caller minimum change in basis points. This is a two-point monthly direction signal using averages on outstanding Treasury debt, not a long-term trend determination, live market yield, forecast, monetary-policy prediction, or investment recommendation.
discovery.resource_description: Compare the latest official monthly average interest rate for one U.S. Treasury security category with the prior month and return rising, falling, unchanged, or human_review. This is not a forecast, live market yield, monetary-policy prediction, or investment recommendation.

buyer.task: Compare the latest official monthly average interest rate for one Treasury security description with the prior month's rate and return a bounded directional signal.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure only independent external settled buyers and repeat demand; never count test responses, discovery visits, or synthetic transactions as sales.

sources.authority: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data monthly Average Interest Rates on U.S. Treasury Securities
sources.refresh_policy: Live official monthly two-observation history lookup on paid request

rules: Require the latest and prior monthly Treasury observations for exactly one unambiguous category.
Compute rate change in basis points and return rising, falling or unchanged relative to minChangeBps.
Do not describe a two-month comparison as a long-term trend or forecast.
the result is a mechanical comparison of official monthly average-interest-rate records
it is not an interest-rate forecast, investment advice, monetary-policy prediction, or recommendation
a two-month directional comparison is not a long-term trend determination

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; payment is not settled.

criteria: Exact-head existing product release gates and deterministic/source checks must pass.
Authority-dependent live smokes and required production credentials (including SEC_USER_AGENT) must pass before any approved deployment.
Complete unit economics and genuine independent external-buyer evidence are unavailable; do not authorize commercial release.
